notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vigor indestructible.
You have the highest life total.
description:
Give Vigor indestructible by any method.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature you don't control, Vigor and each player, and putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
